cases.question: What is the timeout of the service operated by team Orion?

orion-directory.text: Team Orion operates service Quartz. Configuration is in quartz-config.

cases.question: How many retry attempts are allowed for the service managed by team Vega?

vega-directory.text: Team Vega manages service Cedar. Its policy is in cedar-policy.

cases.question: Which team has the lower service timeout, Alpha or Beta? State both timeout values.

teams-directory.text: Alpha uses service Amber; Beta uses service Azure. Their configuration references follow.

amber-config.text: Alpha service Amber timeout is 17 seconds.

azure-config.text: Beta service Azure timeout is 29 seconds.

cases.question: What is the timeout of the service operated by team Nova?

nova-directory.text: Nova service timeout is not documented. There are no further references.
